rules: A company with any ACCOUNTING_SCOPE_REVIEW_PENDING observation in a supplied ledger is withheld entirely (overview and histories).

A history whose selected-quality flag set is exactly one of historical_only, historical_only+multiple_units, multiple_units, multiple_units+partially_historical_units is admitted: its page states that condition in a notice.
A history with any other selected-quality flag set is withheld.
Every other overview and history in the release is admitted.
Withheld pages remain reachable and are served noindex; admission never edits page content.
A filing index and every filing page of an admitted company are admitted; those of a withheld company are withheld.
